entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to start a return. Order number is 788-4B-901.
Okay, I can certainly help with that. Let me pull up order 788-4B-901... I see the AeroLite helmet. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet?
It's the wrong color. Just need to send it back. The box is unopened.
I understand. Is it a technical fault with the helmet, or just a preference regarding the color?
Preference. It doesn't match my gear. Can I return it, yes or no?

Yes, absolutely. I see here it was delivered nine days ago, so you are well within the 90-day return window. We want to ensure you're completely satisfied with both the look and the safety of your gear.
Good. So what's the next step? Just send me the label.

Of course. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next five minutes. Just pack the helmet back in its original packaging, attach the label, and drop it off.
You're welcome. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
